name: nr-list
description: List which hosts have services running outdated libraries, a pending kernel update or outdated microcode.

parameters.name: All hosts
parameters.description: Tick to report on ALL hosts with needrestart installed. Overrides the Hosts selection (which may then stay empty).

parameters.name: Hosts
parameters.description: Hosts to report on (hosts with the needrestart package installed per cdist explorer data). May stay empty when 'All hosts' is ticked.
